# identify time-respecting path from 1010 to 883 in [69317,71717] with max gap 600
start=69317
end=71717
source=1010
target=883

# events variable exists
# Build index of events by u sorted by time
from collections import defaultdict, deque
idx=defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in events:
    if t<start or t> end:
        continue
    idx[u].append((t,v))
for u in idx:
    idx[u].sort()

# find all starting interactions where u==source
starts=idx.get(source, [])
print('num_starts=', len(starts))
if len(starts)==0:
    print('no interactions by source in window')

# BFS over (node, time) states representing arrival at node at a specific time
# Start states are each interaction (source->v at t)
visited=set()
queue=deque()
for t,v in starts:
    state=(v,t)
    queue.append((v,t,[(source,v,t)]))
    visited.add((v,t))

found_paths=[]
while queue:
    node,time,path=queue.popleft()
    # check if node is target
    if node==target:
        found_paths.append(path)
        # don't break; collect all
    # consider outgoing interactions from this node after time and within +600
    if node not in idx:
        continue
    # iterate through idx[node] list of (t2,v2)
    for t2,v2 in idx[node]:
        if t2>time and t2<=time+600:
            state=(v2,t2)
            if state in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append((v2,t2,path+[(node,v2,t2)]))

print('found_paths_count=', len(found_paths))
# print up to 10 paths
for p in found_paths[:10]:
    print(p)

# Also print any interactions that directly involve 883 in window
involving_883=[(u,v,t) for (u,v,t) in events if t>=start and t<=end and (u==883 or v==883)]
print('interactions involving 883 in window:', len(involving_883))
print(involving_883[:20])

# Print starts sample
print('starts sample:', starts[:20])

# Also print earliest and latest times in window with interactions by source and target
times_source=[t for (u,v,t) in events if u==source and t>=start and t<=end]
print('times_source:', sorted(times_source)[:10], 'count', len(times_source))
print('times_target_incoming:', sorted([t for (u,v,t) in events if v==target and t>=start and t<=end])[:10], 'count', len([t for (u,v,t) in events if v==target and t>=start and t<=end]))
